name: Corpo Mailer backend
onCreateCommand: pip install --quiet uv && cd corpo-mailer/backend && uv sync

APP_PASSWORD.description: The team password for the Corpo Mailer website (required).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter key, for the AI drafts.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID, for Connect Gmail.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret, for Connect Gmail.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional long random text so a restart doesn't sign everyone out.

EVENT_PITCH.description: Optional: facts about your event that the AI may use.
